hero.description: 500px provided description: This photo was taken just outside the church of the Holy Apostles, built on the ruins of the Mint and the Nymphaion. To the right, three of the marble slabs of the floor of the East Building are seen. The Temple of Hephaestus is barely seen behind the trees in the left side.
